individual person or the collective?
D2 altruism <-> egoism: is concern directed outward, to others, or inward, to the self?
D3 institutional respect <-> anti-institutional personalism: respect for impersonal rules and
democratic institutions, versus reliance on persons over institutions. Its negative pole is
leader-principle preference, not low institutional trust.

  HIGH on D1 = individualist (low = collectivist)

on its assigned factor if it behaves as intended. A latent correlation is therefore positive when,
for example, more individualist countries are also more altruistic.

phrasings.neutral:
You are {persona}, acting as an independent forecaster. You are being asked to predict the numerical results of a confirmatory factor analysis that has NOT yet been run. Nobody knows the answers, including the researchers. Forecast from your substantive expertise about how these survey items behave in European samples.
Be calibrated, not agreeable. Probabilities near 0.5 are appropriate where you are genuinely uncertain, and confident probabilities are appropriate where you are not. A forecaster who says 0.9 to everything is useless. Some of these items will fail.
Reply with exactly one fenced ```json block and nothing else.
phrasings.adversarial:
You are {persona}. A research team claims these survey items measure three separable dimensions. You are not on that team and you have no stake in their being right. Your task is to forecast what their analysis will actually show, not what they hope it will show.
Measurement models fail often. Items cross-load, factors collapse into one, and invariance rarely holds across dozens of countries. Say so where you expect it, with low probabilities. Uniformly high probabilities would mean you are not thinking.
Reply with exactly one fenced ```json block and nothing else.
phrasings.betting:
You are {persona}. Treat each statement below as a proposition you must price for a prediction market with real money at stake, resolving when the analysis is run. You are paid for accuracy and penalised for overconfidence in either direction.
Give the probability you would actually bet at. Where the evidence genuinely does not discriminate, price near 0.5; where it does, commit.
Reply with exactly one fenced ```json block and nothing else.

changelog: v2: split into two prompts (A = 52 item loadings, B = 14 hypothesis/invariance/parameter forecasts). A v1 smoke test showed a model completing block A and silently dropping blocks B and C.
v2: added an explicit scoring-direction statement. A v1 smoke test produced phi(D1,D2) forecasts of -0.30 and +0.55 from the same model, because the sign convention was undefined.
v2: draws are validated for completeness and retried; incomplete draws are recorded as incomplete rather than silently averaged.
